selectionPolicy.first17: Existing manifest.json order and published binder target are preserved exactly.
selectionPolicy.remainingOrder: Original design.csv row order, excluding the first 17 UUIDs.
selectionPolicy.representativeTarget: Smallest positive reported Adaptyv KD among intended targets with literal hit; otherwise highest published intended-target final_score.
selectionPolicy.ties: Original intended_toxins order; no rounding before comparison.
selectionPolicy.qualifiers: Upper limits and approximate KD values retain their qualification. Comparing their reported numeric values is a deterministic representative-selection convention, not a proof of exact affinity ordering.
selectionPolicy.blankCells: An empty published cell is retained as an empty string and means unreported/not measured/not applicable/no fit, never no hit.
selectionPolicy.scores: final_score is the published mean of six computational scores (ipSAE and scDockQ for three predictors), not a KD or experimental binding measurement.
selectionPolicy.binderClassification: Only design.csv binder_against defines a dataset binder; an Adaptyv hit alone does not meet the full published criteria.

coordinateStatus: Catalog only. Source models are original published predicted complexes; alignment groups and reference entries are planning metadata, not completed coordinate transformations or shared render bounds.
